description: The peer's bitmap acknowledges only the middle of three D_PDUs: the one at its RX LWE and the one after the last acknowledged are taken to have failed and are retransmitted, in FSN order, with the same FSNs.
note: Link setup as cas/make-caller-accepted: conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ, its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 makes the CAS call the peer (Ed4 request out at 75000, sent at 80550), and at 91000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED makes the link with the 16-bit family (B-0219, B-0142): window edges TX LWE 0, TX UWE 65535, RX LWE 0, RX UWE 65535 (C-0782, C-0787). The held U_PDU goes down as an ARQ C_PDU (A-0194) and dts.ttd runs to its TTD (C-1050). The burst ends at 92000 with the EOT prediction at 96000 ahead and data queued: csma.vdcd_end; at 96000 LBT rule 1 (the burst was addressed only to us, K-0067) and contention, 12000 ms (second draw). The 18-byte C_PDU (U_PDU 'twelve bytes') is three 6-byte segments. At 108000 FSNs 0, 1 and 2 go in one 3-block transmission (EOTs 30, 20, 10; TX WIN LWE on FSN 0, TX WIN UWE on FSN 2, C-1122), ending at 123150, when dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts. At 131000 the ACK-ONLY: RX LWE 0 and one bitmap byte 0x01, so FSN 1 was received (C-0202, C-0207) and FSN 0, at RX LWE, was not (C-0776); FSN 2 lies beyond the last D_PDU explicitly acknowledged, so on our half duplex channel it is taken to have failed too (C-0910, C-1121). Both are failed (C-0907, C-0908), none awaits an acknowledgement, and dts.ack_wait stops. The burst ends at 132000: csma.vdcd_end to 136000, LBT rule 1, contention 45000 ms. At 181000 the failed D_PDUs are retransmitted (C-0904), ahead of any first transmission (C-0852, C-0905), in FSN order (C-1132), with their FSNs and segments unchanged: FSN 0 (C_PDU START, TX WIN LWE) and FSN 2 (C_PDU END, TX WIN UWE); 2 blocks, EOTs 20 and 10. At 191350 dts.ack_wait starts; at 201000 RX LWE 3 acknowledges everything: dts.ack_wait stops, the C_PDU is confirmed (C-0679, C-1130) and dts.ttd is cancelled. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Fill (C-1154): no transmission here has room in its last block for a copy of its ACK-ONLY (15 or more bytes) or for a PADDING D_PDU (11 bytes), so each is zero filled.  The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326).
